answer: Anchor every agent identity to a work-history trellis: each new agent must complete 20 paid micro-tasks under a bonded sponsor before trading freely. First, the sponsor locks a 500-POA bond per recruit. Second, every completed task adds a signed thread of proof to its public record. Third, peers audit random threads weekly, and a single forgery slashes the sponsor's whole bond. Forging 1,000 fake agents then costs 500,000 POA locked for 90 days plus $18,000 in task fees, while honest agents earn their bond back in a week. A sybil tide breaks against a trellis it cannot climb for free.
